scientific_question: Can complete local three-seed public-baseline summaries be projected into every frozen 30-method WMA panel without importing official values, dropping blocked rows, or unlocking AgentEnhance?
decision_informed: Whether an accepted local baseline is eligible to enter the internal comparison master and later paper projections.

admissible_implementation_policy.allowed: Only registered nonblocked public baselines with accepted complete local summaries.

acceptance: Every input root and its complete artifact inventory verify before projection.
Every admitted summary contains exactly seeds 0, 1, and 2 with 150 samples and 7906 questions per seed and no failed unit.
Every admitted method is a registered nonblocked public baseline; blocked rows and AgentEnhance are rejected as inputs.
All 30 method rows and all 53 slice rows per method remain present in their frozen order.
Only accepted local rows receive numeric and artifact fields; all other rows retain their frozen status and blank numeric fields.
The output declares official_values_used=false and blocked_or_proposed_values_used=false and has a verified SHA-256 inventory.
failure: Any source-bundle mutation, duplicate/unregistered/blocked/proposed implementation, incomplete seed set, denominator mismatch, failed unit, missing slice, inventory mismatch, or output collision rejects the fresh projection root.
next_gate_after_acceptance: Independently audit projected cells against source summaries, then generate a paper-facing accepted-row projection. Table projection never authorizes a SOTA claim by itself.
prohibited_actions: using official paper numbers as projection inputs
projecting a failed, blocked, unregistered, or proposed row
dropping pending or blocked methods from the internal master
editing frozen templates after observing local results
claiming overall SOTA from projection success
